title: SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection
abstract: arXiv:2611.16929v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The easy access to Large Language Models (LLMs) has made AI-generated texts on the web increasingly ubiquitous, making AI-text detection a crucial task. Prompts greatly influence the generation process, but existing detectors focus solely on the generated texts --- supervised methods learn from labeled texts only, and zero-shot methods rely on the text's probability distributions --- ignoring the underlying generation process, which limits their robustness in open-world scenarios. We introduce SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection, a novel framework for detecting AI-generated text that transfers better across datasets. Specifically, we measure the prompt's influence and use it as a discriminative signal. translated_title: SPADE：用于AI文本检测的软提示
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.16929v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）的易于获取使得网络上由AI生成的文本日益普遍，这让AI文本检测成为一项至关重要的任务。提示词对文本生成过程有很大影响，但现有的检测器仅关注生成的文本本身——有监督方法仅从带标签的文本中学习，零样本方法则依赖文本的概率分布——而忽略了底层的生成过程，这限制了它们在开放世界场景中的鲁棒性。我们提出了SPADE：用于AI文本检测的软提示，这是一个新颖的AI生成文本检测框架，具有更好的跨数据集迁移能力。具体而言，我们测量提示词的影响并将其作为判别信号。我们通过引入逐点互信息（PMI）项来刻画提示词的影响，该度量捕捉了提示词能在多大程度上解释一段文本。基于这一量度，SPADE为每个类别训练一个软提示来放大类别间的可分性。
tldr: SPADE通过引入逐点互信息（PMI）来量化提示词对文本的解释程度，并为每个类别训练软提示作为判别信号，从而实现了跨数据集迁移能力更强的AI生成文本检测。
en_tdlr: SPADE leverages Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) to quantify how much a prompt explains a text and trains class-specific soft prompts as discriminative signals, achieving AI-generated text detection with better cross-dataset transferability.
